data.body_html:
Ringing in 2028 from the Mediterranean is a memory that sticks. A Puerto Banús yacht charter for New Year's Eve 2027 gives you front-row seats to the fireworks, the glittering coastline, and the exclusive vibe of Marbella's most famous marina. With prices starting at €749 for two hours on a luxury motor yacht, it's an upgrade from any restaurant table. Here's everything you need to plan the night.

Why Choose a Yacht for New Year's Eve in Puerto Banús?

Puerto Banús transforms on 31 December. The marina is packed, the restaurants are full, and the atmosphere is electric. But a private yacht offers something a restaurant cannot: your own floating party, complete with a skipper, open bar, and a panoramic view of the fireworks from the water. You control the music, the guest list, and the itinerary. No queues, no crowds, just you and the sea.

Our Fleet for New Year's Eve 2027

We operate a diverse fleet from Puerto Banús. For a large group, consider the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) or the Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax). For a more intimate celebration, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) or Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) are excellent value. Smaller boats like the Speedboat (7m, 6 pax) are perfect for couples or small families. All depart from Puerto Banús and include full safety equipment.

Pricing: What to Expect

Our transparent pricing means no surprises. Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) cost €749 for 2 hours, €1,299 for 4 hours, €1,799 for 6 hours, or €2,299 for 8 hours. The Mangusta 80 (white or grey) is €4,719 for a minimum 4 hours, and includes a free jet ski. All other boats (including the Ferretti 94, Canados 86, and Maiora 26m) are priced on request via WhatsApp. Every charter includes skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and 21% VAT.

Sample New Year's Eve Itinerary

  • 22:00 – Board at Puerto Banús. Welcome glass of cava.
  • 22:30 – Cruise along the Golden Mile toward Marbella's coastline.
  • 23:30 – Anchor near the bay for prime fireworks viewing.
  • 00:00 – Midnight fireworks. Toast with champagne.
  • 00:30 – Return cruise to Puerto Banús, with music and drinks.
  • 01:00 – Disembark. Continue the night at a marina club or restaurant.

What's Included in Every Charter

No hidden extras. Your charter includes: licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). You can bring your own food and decorations. For special catering, just ask – we can arrange it.

Tips for an Unforgettable Night

  • Book early – NYE is our busiest night. Slots fill by November.
  • Dress in layers – December evenings can be cool on the water (10–12°C).
  • Bring a playlist – Most boats have Bluetooth or AUX input.
  • Consider a longer charter – 4–8 hours gives you time to relax and enjoy.
  • Ask about the jet ski – included free on the Mangusta 80 charter.

How to Book Your Puerto Banús Yacht Charter for New Year's Eve 2027

Ready to celebrate? Contact us via WhatsApp for fastest response. We'll confirm availability, take a deposit, and send you a confirmation. For more inspiration, browse our full fleet and pricing. Don't wait – the best boats go first.

What is the best boat for a New Year's Eve party in Puerto Banús?

For a large group, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) or Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) offer ample deck space and luxury. For a smaller, more affordable option, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) or Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) are excellent. All depart from Puerto Banús.

How much does a New Year's Eve yacht charter cost?

Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) start at €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours. The Mangusta 80 is €4,719 for a minimum 4 hours, including a free jet ski. Other boats are priced on request via WhatsApp.

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden costs.

Yes. The best views are from the bay near Puerto Banús or off Marbella's Golden Mile. Your skipper will anchor at a prime spot to see the midnight fireworks displays along the coast.

Capacity varies by boat: from 5 pax (Dubhe, Mariah SX21) up to 12 pax (Mangusta 80, Ferretti 94, Canados 86). Check individual boat specs for exact limits. All include safety equipment for the number of guests.
